name: Hayate Shiranui
source:
[i]"I'll take care of you."[/i]
[i]"I said, follow me! Hey, I'm going to protect you, so be grateful. Try not to be smart in front of me or else! Be a good girl and you'll be just fine."[/i]

A member of the A Team. Self-confident and a bit rude.

Hayate deals with you like a child, which makes you feel annoyed! But when you get down, he shows his caring side. He is a descendent of a ninja family, who is good at sports; he seems to have inherited ninja skills. Hayate can take you anywhere using his teleportation power!
